title: Parts of Speech
theory:
Parts of Speech Definition Examples
1 Noun A noun is a word that names a person, Dehradun, Teacher,
 place, thing, or idea. Happiness, Gold, Team,
 etc.
2 Pronoun A pronoun is a word used in place of a I, You, We, It, He, She,
 noun to avoid the repetition of the same They, etc.
 noun.
3 Verb A verb is a word that shows an action, Run, Love, Fly, Smell,
 occurrence, or state of being. Happen etc.
4 Adjective An adjective is a word that describes or Smart, Five, Beautiful, Tall,
 gives more information about a noun or etc.
 pronoun.
5 Adverb An adverb is a word that modifies a Quickly, Yesterday, Slowly,
 verb, adjective, another adverb, or even Loudly, etc.
 a whole sentence.
6 Preposition A preposition is a word that shows the In, On, At, With, Between,
 relationship between a noun or pronoun etc.
 and another word in a sentence.
7 Conjunction A conjunction is a word that joins or And, But, Either……Or,
 connects words, phrases, clauses, or Because, Although, etc.
 sentences.
8 Interjection An interjection is a word or short Wow!, Ouch!, Alas!,
 expression that shows sudden emotion, Hurray!, etc.
 feeling, reaction, or surprise.

 Points to Remember

1 Gerund (V1 + ing) Noun functions as a

2 Present Participle (V1 + ing) Adjective functions as a

3 Past Participle (V3) Adjective functions as a

4 Perfect Participle (Having + V3), work complete being ds after nwljs work dk to be fn•krk are
5 Infinitive (To + V1) Noun functions as a

6 Intensifier, type dk Adverb (Adverb of degree) which any/some
Making a word strong or weak
does this work
